findings.issue: 中位 here is the degree sense ('medium' doneness, as the gloss itself says), read ちゅうくらい/ちゅうぐらい. ちゅうい is the 'middle rank/position' sense and does not fit 焼いてください doneness context; looks like an analyzer-default reading. Romaji chuui mirrors the error.
findings.current: すてーきわちゅういでやいてください。
findings.suggested: すてーきわちゅうくらいでやいてください。

findings.issue: Reading of 中位 in the 'medium degree/doneness' sense (the sense given in this token's own gloss) is ちゅうくらい (or ちゅうぐらい), not ちゅうい, which means middle rank/position.

Subject mismatch inside the record: en ('You should have gone on singing'), pt ('Você devia...') and lit_pt/expl_pt ('não fez/não continuou') all read the sentence as 2nd person, but lit_en supplies 'I', contradicting them.
findings.current: I should have kept singing the whole time, and yet (I didn't).
findings.suggested: You should have kept singing the whole time, and yet (you didn't).

findings.issue: jp is a polite request (〜てください: 'please grill the steak medium'); en is a statement of preference, mismatching the speech act and the pt ('Por favor, faça o bife ao ponto'), which correctly renders the request.

Closing paraphrase uses 1st person ('I should have kept singing') while en/pt and expl_pt ('mas (não continuou)') imply 2nd person; the two explanation versions are inconsistent with each other and with the translations.
findings.current: 'I should have kept singing, but (I didn't)'
findings.suggested: 'you should have kept singing, but (you didn't)'

findings.issue: Imprecise morphology: し is not the stem of ます — まし is (the token note itself says まし = 連用形 of ます). Should say the second し is part of まし. Same wording in expl_pt ('o segundo し é o radical de ます').
findings.current: and the second し is the stem of ます
findings.suggested: and the second し is part of まし, the 連用形 (stem) of ます

findings.issue: Spurious 'do': 'do meu muito-querido esporte é' reads as 'is of my sport' (possession), garbling the predicate; の is already rendered by 'meu' (lit_en has no 'of': 'is my very favorite sport').
findings.current: Esqui, quanto a (ele), do meu muito-querido esporte é.
findings.suggested: Esqui, quanto a (ele), meu muito-querido esporte é.

findings.issue: Misplaced parenthesis: the '(' opened before 'literally' never closes until the very end, swallowing the whole すぐに sentence; punctuation garbled identically in expl_pt.
findings.current: + いい ('good') (literally 'the option of sleeping is the good one'. The adverb すぐ + に at the beginning means 'immediately, right now'...
findings.suggested: + いい ('good'), literally 'the option of sleeping is the good one'. The adverb すぐに at the beginning means 'immediately, right now'...
